  Ability to translate ambiguous scientific or business problems into testable quantitative approaches 
  Experience working with multiple types of data, such as tabular, time-series, spatial, sensor, spectral, or image data

  Strong programming and general computer science fundamentals

  Geospatial analysis

STR is seeking a motivated and versatile Software Developer to join our Strategic Projects, Analytics & Applications (SPAA) team within the Operations Division. SPAA is responsible for developing and sustaining enterprise business capabilities through cross-functional project execution, business analytics, and business applications management.
This position will support the design, development, integration, and maintenance of software tools and applications that improve business processes, automate workflows, and enable data-driven decision-making across STR.
Working closely with the Business Analytics and Business Applications functional leads, the Software Developer will develop and maintain solutions that support enterprise reporting, data integration, business system administration, and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate will be a technically capable, creative problem-solver who enjoys collaborating with business stakeholders to translate operational needs into reliable, scalable software solutions.

Collaborate with Business Analytics, Business Applications, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, identify opportunities for automation and process improvement, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
Develop product roadmaps, prioritize and maintain feature backlogs, and communicate progress to project stakeholders.
Design, develop, and test software applications, tools, integrations, APIs, and automated workflows that support enterprise business operations, including STR's enterprise data warehouse and associated data processing capabilities.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to accelerate software development, testing, and maintenance.
Deploy and maintain containerized applications (e.g., Docker, Podman) using CI/CD pipelines, source control, and automated testing to ensure reliable software delivery.
Collaborate with IT and cybersecurity teams to ensure solutions meet STR's technical, infrastructure, and security requirements.
Troubleshoot, maintain, and enhance existing applications, scripts, integrations, and automation tools, providing ongoing operational support and technical documentation.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to software development practices, system reliability, and enterprise capabilities.

Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
Minimum of 2 years of professional software development experience
Proficiency in Python and experience with one or more additional programming languages, such as C++ or Java
Experience using AI-assisted software development tools and coding agents, such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar technologies
Experience developing, testing, and maintaining software solutions intended for reliable enterprise use
Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker and Podman
Experience with Git-based source control, CI/CD tools such as GitLab, and automated build and deployment pipelines
Working knowledge of Linux environments and basic system administration
Understanding of IT cybersecurity fundamentals and secure software development practices
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to independently investigate and resolve technical challenges
Organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple development and support priorities
Demonstrated communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Nice to have:
Experience developing software tools and integrations supporting enterprise resource planning (ERP), financial, HR, or other business applications
Experience with SQL, relational databases, data engineering, ETL/ELT pipelines, or data warehouse technologies
Experience developing REST APIs, web applications, or internal business tools
Familiarity with Power BI, business intelligence platforms, or analytical data environments
Experience developing AI-enabled applications, including large language model integrations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or agent-based workflows

Experience supporting U.S. Government contracting organizations
